text.title: Ads Analytics Setup Failure Modes
text.summary: 7 antipatterns observed in real deployments of Ads Analytics Setup — code-first events, late BQ link, free-form UTM, unverified go-live, reserved event names, malformed UTM values, SPA page_view before route settles. Each pairs symptom + sourced root-cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: 20 events implemented ad-hoc; 6 months later naming inconsistent; analyst rewrites schema; historical data unusable.
antipattern.fix: Write spec doc with name / params / trigger / owner per event; freeze before coding.

antipattern.symptom: GA4 live 6 months; team links BigQuery now; first 6 months of raw events permanently lost.
antipattern.fix: Link BQ on day one of every new property; for legacy properties, link now and document the loss window.

antipattern.symptom: Source values include 'facebook', 'Facebook', 'FB', 'fb.com'; attribution splits across 4 buckets.
antipattern.fix: Document convention (lowercase, controlled vocab); validate at link-builder; backfill historical via lookup table.

antipattern.symptom: Conversion event misfires for 45 days; only discovered when budget reviewer asks why CPA looks great.
antipattern.fix: Wire DebugView verification step into release checklist; require screenshot evidence per event.

antipattern.symptom: Using GA4 reserved event names (session_start, first_visit, etc.) for custom events.
antipattern.root-cause: Reserved event names cause silent collision with GA4's automatically collected events. The custom events will either be dropped or overwrite system data, corrupting session metrics.
antipattern.fix: Rename the custom event; check every name in the event spec against the GA4 reserved list before coding.

antipattern.symptom: Using spaces or uppercase letters in UTM values.
antipattern.root-cause: Spaces get encoded as %20 or + differently across browsers and tools. Mixed case creates separate entries in GA4 reports. Both produce reporting fragmentation that requires manual cleanup.
antipattern.fix: Lowercase, underscore-separated values only; enforce via the exported UTM constants (utm-constants-in-code rule).

antipattern.symptom: Firing page_view events in single-page apps before the URL route is settled.
antipattern.root-cause: GTM fires on history change events immediately. In some frameworks, the route update completes asynchronously after the history push. Early fires record the previous URL as the page_view location.
antipattern.fix: Fire page_view from the router's post-navigation hook, not from the raw history change trigger; verify the recorded location in DebugView.
